python3 -c "
import zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
def L(t): return t.split('}')[-1]
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
print('Sheets:', [(s.get('name'), s.get('sheetId')) for s in wb.iter() if L(s.tag)=='sheet'])
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
for row in root.iter():
    if L(row.tag)!='row': continue
    cells={}
    for c in row:
        if L(c.tag)!='c': continue
        ref=c.get('r'); t=c.get('t'); val=None
        for ch in c:
            ln=L(ch.tag)
            if ln=='v': val=ch.text
            elif ln=='is': val=''.join(x.text or '' for x in ch.iter() if L(x.tag)=='t')
        cells[ref]=(t,val)
    for ref in sorted(cells, key=lambda x:(int(''.join(ch for ch in x if ch.isdigit())), x)):
        print(ref, cells[ref])
    print('---')
"
